Sajid Akram is the alleged gunman who opened fire at a Hanukkah event on Bondi Beach in December 2022. The hero officer is a member of the NSW Police credited with tackling and disarming the shooter.
event_title: Hero officer who took down Bondi shooter praised as footage reveals how massacre was brought to an end
